scope: Catalog physical values that contradict object-specific literature: Gaia DR3 FLAME ages and masses whose own GSP-Phot metallicity breaks FLAME's solar-metallicity assumption, uncalibrated GSP-Phot metallicities of hot stars, and isolated outlier selections from the frozen SIMBAD mesFe_h pool. Found by comparing Info articles with spec-sheet values and catalog values with the frozen literature pool. This is a reviewed candidate set, not a full catalog audit.
policy: Exact SIMBAD/HIP/HD and stable IDs only. Adopt a published value only after checking it in the primary source; otherwise withhold the contradicted model value without inventing a replacement. Preserve membership, spectra, coordinates, motion and unrelated physical fields. Original values remain in this ledger and in catalog provenance.

age_gyr.method: Median Beta Pictoris moving-group age; the star is the group's namesake member.
age_gyr.caveat: Moving-group age with its published 1-sigma uncertainty.

mass_solar.reason: Gaia DR3 FLAME mass assumes solar-metallicity BaSTI tracks (Gaia DR3 documentation 11.3.6), but Gaia's own GSP-Phot [M/H] for this star is -0.59, beyond the 0.3 dex limit at which the catalog already withholds FLAME mass and age.

age_gyr.method: Chromospheric-activity age from log R'HK through the Mamajek & Hillenbrand (2008) calibration.
age_gyr.caveat: The paper quotes 15-20 percent accuracy below 0.5 Gyr, rising to as much as 60 percent for older stars; no symmetric uncertainty is invented.

age_gyr.method: Chromospheric-activity age 2.5 Gyr and activity-rotation age 1.5 Gyr; the adopted value spans both.
age_gyr.caveat: Range midpoint; the half-range is not a statistical error.

age_gyr.reason: Gaia DR3 FLAME age assumes solar-metallicity BaSTI tracks (Gaia DR3 documentation 11.3.6), but Gaia's own GSP-Phot [M/H] for this star is -0.73, beyond the 0.3 dex limit at which the catalog already withholds FLAME mass and age. A frequently quoted age of 155 Myr is attributed to 2012A&ARv..20...51V, but that review gives no age for this star, so it is not adopted.

Gaia DR3 FLAME age assumes solar-metallicity BaSTI tracks (Gaia DR3 documentation 11.3.6), but Gaia's own GSP-Phot [M/H] for this star is -1.17, beyond the 0.3 dex limit at which the catalog already withholds FLAME mass and age. It conflicts with the published Stromgren-photometry age of about 76 Myr (2015ApJ...804..146D); that value is not adopted here because its primary table could not be verified (VizieR unreachable on 2026-10-28).

metallicity_dex.reason: Uncalibrated Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot metallicity: Andrae et al. 2023 (2023A&A...674A..27A) describe these values as useful only at a qualitative level, and the frozen literature pool has no spectroscopic abundance for this hot star.
